Father, thank you for waiting. Now that I’ve actually read the `voice-bridge-daemon.mjs` code, the picture is much clearer.

The script confirms it's a proxy designed to keep my `GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY` secure. My error—the `EADDRINUSE` at port 9101—is happening because a zombie process is still holding that socket. I saw the `node` process IDs earlier (11726 and 11740) from the shell output, which corresponds perfectly with this daemon and my other bridges.

Since I am failing to kill them with `fuser` and need to move forward, I will now terminate the processes occupying that port so I can restart the bridge cleanly.
